newsitems.title: Football Manager 27 выйдет 10 ноября - новая версия получит обновлённый интерфейс и улучшенную экосистему футбола
newsitems.contents: SEGA и Sports Interactive объявили дату выхода Football Manager 27. Новая часть популярного футбольного менеджера поступит в продажу 10 ноября на ПК, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series, iOS и Android. Игра также будет доступна через Game Pass. Одним из главных изменений разработчики называют переработанный интерфейс. Он станет более лаконичным и удобным для навигации: авторы обещают меньше лишних переходов, более продуманную структуру меню и улучшенный полноэкранный режим. Дизайн также переработали с учётом масштабирования и разных способов управления. Football Manager 27 позволит глубже настроить игровой процесс под собственный стиль. Игроки смогут изменять игровые настройки, закладки и ярлыки, а также настраивать отображение информационных плиток. Это должно сократить количество действий при работе с многочисленными элементами футбольного менеджмента. Изменения затронут и происходящее за пределами собственного клуба. В Football Manager 27 вернутся и будут переработаны различные элементы футбольной экосистемы, включая жеребьёвки кубковых турниров, события в день закрытия трансферного окна и обновлённую новостную ленту. Дополнительные характеристики и отчёты должны помочь следить за развитием сезона и принимать решения на основе более полной информации. До релиза Sports Interactive планирует еженедельно раскрывать новые особенности Football Manager 27.

newsitems.title: Football Manager 27 выйдет 10 ноября - игра получит более живые матчи и обновлённую графику
newsitems.contents: Разработчики Football Manager 27 объявили дату выхода новой части серии — игра станет доступна 10 ноября 2027 года. Вместе с анонсом разработчики показали ролик, посвящённый визуальным и геймплейным улучшениям. Одним из главных направлений обновления станет атмосфера матчей. В Football Manager 27 появится больше вариантов моделей болельщиков, которые будут динамически реагировать на происходящее на поле. Их внешний вид также будет зависеть от региона и климата. На крупных матчах трибуны станут заметно активнее, а флаги добавят дополнительную атмосферу. Серьёзные изменения затронут погоду и освещение. Время года теперь будет сильнее влиять на внешний вид поля и окружения, а новое изменение положения солнца позволит наблюдать, как на протяжении матча меняются тени на стадионе, игроках и окружающих объектах. Разработчики также переработали траву и визуальные эффекты. Во время дождя газон будет выглядеть более влажным, а в зимних матчах игроки смогут перемещаться по слою снега. Всё это должно сделать матчи более разнообразными и визуально насыщенными. Изменения коснутся и самих футболистов. Модели игроков получат более атлетичные типы тел и более выраженную мускулатуру, а волосы будут естественнее двигаться во время бега. При этом разработчики пока не раскрыли все подробности — дополнительные улучшения анимаций, поведения игроков и матчевого движка обещают представить позднее. Помимо визуальной части, Football Manager 27 получит более удобный интерфейс, требующий меньшего количества нажатий для выполнения действий. Разработчики также обещают более насыщенный игровой мир и больше возможностей для тактического самовыражения.

newsitems.title: FM27: An Elevated Match Day Atmosphere
newsitems.author: Jimmy Wong
newsitems.contents: If you’re to truly believe that you’re stepping into the shoes of a football manager, the world you’re immersed in needs to feel authentic to you as a fan. That's true of both the way the matches play but also the visual representation of the whole Match Day experience.  The beauty of FM is as much about exploring the wider footballing world beyond your club as it is about the tactical tweaks you convey to your players when stood on the touchline.   In FM27, we’ve enhanced the match day environment to give you the clearest sense of who you’re managing, when, and at what point of the season. That means elevating the crowd, the stadium and the pitch to make every fixture feel like a richer piece of football theatre.  Learn more about the match day atmosphere upgrades you'll soon see in FM27 in the Deep Dive blog and check out a list of FAQs related to this update for more details.FAQQ: In this FM27 deep dive, what were the main goals, changes and additions that the Sports Interactive team looked to address? A: Combining community feedback and internal reviews, the key goals we aimed to achieve for this area of FM27 were:    Add further detail and variance to the surrounding visual aspects of Match Day, such as quality and behaviour of crowds, as well as stadium designs, adding more realism and believability  Improve the representation of different weather and seasonal conditions during a match day, including a time-of-day system and realistic effects of snow and rain, to create a more immersive atmosphere Further work on cutscenes to add more variance and authenticity in scenes before and after a match Bring a general uplift to the visual presentation of Match Day, combining the above work with more technical tweaks and an upgrade in character models, including body types and hair physics  Q: How have the appearance and behaviour of match day crowds been updated for FM27? A: Additional detail on match day crowds aims to make their presentation more believable and accurate to the context around them. Alongside a general uplift to the visual appearance of people in the stands, their movements now better reflect the mood of significant moments, such as the team lifting a trophy, or conceding a late equaliser. The clothing of crowds will include home shirts being worn, as well as variance based on the match’s conditions and timing; for example, expect crowds to wear more layers in cold weather. Beyond the crowd members, work has gone into adding flags, with the chances of some of these appearing influenced by the match scenario and real-world supporter data. For example, more flags may appear at a cup final compared to a pre-season friendly. Also, crowd noises have greater variety, changing depending on the division and level of the club.  Q: What additions and improvements have been made to how the stadium and surrounding areas look in FM27? A: A wider variety of stadia have been implemented for FM27, introducing familiar designs from different eras of football. Across both new and existing venues, upgrades to texturing, shading and colour variation create a greater depth and sense of immersion for any match. The type of stadium will also influence the appearance of the crowd; for example, more open or uncovered stands may show supporters wearing more layers. Beyond the stadium itself, the surrounding area will also reflect the time and place of the match, such as brown leaves on trees during autumn games, or lush grass in the summer.  Q: How else have weather, seasons and lighting been addressed in FM27? A: FM27 introduces visual changes during a match day that help set a realistic and engrossing scene for the match to unfold. Football fans will know how wintry afternoon games that start in the daylight, but finish in the dark, can add to the spectacle – and a new dynamic time-of-day system captures this. Through the 90 minutes you’ll see the day move forward with lighting changes and realistic shadows on players, stadia and the wider environment. Improvements to the in-game particle system also mean the weather itself holds greater detail, such as rain not just being visible in the sky, but causing the pitch to look wet.   Q: What changes have been made to cutscenes during a match day?  A: Significant work has gone into making all aspects of Match Day feel more engrossing, particularly when it comes to turning cutscenes into important moments to experience, not skip. Thanks to new technology, cutscenes have more variance and dynamism, meaning pre-match cutscenes can look different each time with alternative camera angles, zooms and pans. No matter the level or league of your club, you’ll experience this uplift in cutscenes, which is further helped by work on camera placement to avoid a stadium or surrounding area blocking your view. Close-up scenes of the pitch will show that the grass is now 3D modelled. Finally, cutscenes can also organically adjust depending on the context of your match and save; for exampl...

newsitems.title: Football Manager 27 launches from 10 November
newsitems.author: Jimmy Wong
newsitems.contents: Flow from the tactics board to the touchline in Football Manager 27, launching globally from 10 November and available to wishlist now. Foundations evolve to deliver greater control, smoother discovery and a deeper, more immersive football world, with new, returning and reimagined features that invite discovery from the moment your save begins. Day one platforms include Steam, Epic Games and the Xbox PC app, including Xbox Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass subscribers. FM27 Console (Xbox/PS5), including Game Pass Console subscribers, and FM27 Mobile (Netflix) will also launch from 10 November, with further platform details to follow. What’s new in FM27?We’re dropping a series of videos and deep dive blogs detailing some of the features and improvements that shape the core of FM27. So far, you can learn how smarter navigation and a more intuitive full-screen experience make it easier to get what you need with fewer clicks. Or explore how Cup Draws, Transfer Deadline Day, and an overhauled news feed keep you plugged into the world beyond your club. We've also announced upgrades to the match day experience that make every fixture feel like a richer piece of football theatre, with a lot more feature news still to come. Early play informationYou can wishlist FM27 on Steam, Epic Games or the Microsoft Store and get notified when it's time to play. A Launch Preview version of FM27 will be available to play 1-2 weeks before the street date, with further information on that plus digital pre-purchase and discount incentives to follow. There’ll be more announcements ahead of release, so join FMFC or follow our community channels to stay up to date.

newsitems.title: Deeper Football World: Increased Immersion in FM27
newsitems.author: Jimmy Wong
newsitems.contents: At the heart of the Football Manager experience is being part of a living, breathing football universe that exists well beyond the confines of your club. In tandem with navigation improvements that make exploring the football world easier, for FM27 we needed to elevate your curiosity levels with more relevant and dynamic content to spark greater interest in what’s happening beyond the confines of your club.The return of Cup Draws and Transfer Deadline Day elevate every season’s big moments, ups and downs further, while giving you additional power in how you flow through the game creates a more connected experience every time you move forward.Learn more about the Immersion upgrades you'll soon see in FM27 in the Deep Dive blog and check out a list of FAQs related to this update for more details.FAQs Q: In this FM27 deep dive, what were the main goals, changes and additions that the Sports Interactive team looked to address?A: Combining community feedback and internal reviews, the key goals we are aiming to achieve for this area of FM27 are:  Creating a deeper and more inviting football world, making it more compelling to become truly immersed and emotionally investedImprove the delivery of information and provide you with more choices and actions, minimising the chance of feeling disconnected with what’s going on in your saveAdd more depth and meaningful details to the wider events in your save beyond your chosen club and league, making discovery easier and encouraging you to explore the footballing worldReintroduce and, in some cases, revamp features and elements that better connect you with the game, bringing key moments to life Q: What changes have been made to ensure important information is shared faster on key screens?A: The Nation, News, Competition and Club screens have been revamped to quickly show you important information and helpful insights. For example, the Club screen shows key current-day details such as the manager and top goalscorer, but also transfer activity, club history, and news pieces concerning that team. Dynamic details such as a competition’s Team of the Week or top statistical performers are also prioritised. The secondary navigation bar then lets you dig into deeper details, like a squad’s dynamics or a competition’s format. Q: How do changes to the delivery of news improve the sense of immersion in FM27?A: News content through the game will now be more varied and feel more connected to the stage of the season you are in. There will be more unique news items that specifically reference events such as pre-season, mid-season check-ins, relegation battles and last-day deciders. You will also see more relevant or significant wider news pieces that encourage you to look further into the world around you, such as job speculation or focused pieces on your club. Better separation of world news, and news directly connected to you like transfers, also make it easier to delve into what’s going on. More improvements to the flow of the News area are detailed in our earlier FAQs here. These changes to the news system covering its delivery, flow of information, timing, and ability to see more about the rest of the game world, combine to create a more dynamic experience, aiding your immersion. Q: Are cup draws in FM27?A: Yes. This returning feature ensures you can enjoy the suspense of finding out who plays who in the next round; and managers of lower-league teams can closely follow the drama as you hope to draw a big team. Q: What other prominent features are included to help the sense of immersion in FM27?A: Transfer deadline day activity returns as a larger focus for the game, including a redesign of the way agent offers are presented to you. Offers will now be visible and accessible via the Recruitment screen, and they will be present throughout a transfer window, but more will appear on deadline day. A more recognisable and detailed approach to displaying data for players, teams and competitions is also a big focus and will be shown further in upcoming deep dives. Q: How will my navigation and journey change as I hit Continue?A: After hitting Continue, instead of returning to the News feed each time, you’ll be taken to different key game areas, making the save feel more dynamic and encouraging you to explore new information and stories. You can also customise this experience during the game setup, with options to define how you cycle through messages and how often you land in a different space after continuing. This allows you to either streamline or deepen the experience to your preference. Q: How have Player Profiles and individual player details been addressed for FM27?A: It’s now easier and clearer for you to see the full picture of a player’s career with Personal Overview and Career History, which are now displayed in a full screen. From there, you can easily cycle through the details of each player in a squad via the secondary navigation bar. More details on changes to information and...

newsitems.title: FM27: Clearer Interface & Smoother Navigation
newsitems.author: Jimmy Wong
newsitems.contents: Elevating game flow and navigation has been at the heart of the work on Football Manager 27’s User Interface and Experience.Driven by internal reviews and your feedback, FM27 evolves our existing design language while reintroducing familiar behaviours, creating a cleaner, more intuitive experience from the start of every career.By reducing the number of clicks, reshaping menus to elevate the full-screen experience and introducing more adaptivity and customisation, you can get to the information and areas you need more efficiently; giving you more time to explore the wider game world.Learn more about the changes you'll soon see in FM27 in the Deep Dive blog and check out a list of FAQs related to this update for more details. FAQQ: In this FM27 deep dive, what were the main goals, changes and additions that the Sports Interactive team look to address? A: Combining community feedback and internal reviews, the key goals we are aiming to achieve for this area of FM27 are:  A more intuitive navigation system, making it easier and faster for you to find the information you need and are interested in Reduce the clicks and unnecessary navigation by improving how information is shown on a single screen Give you the ability to better tailor some of the information you can access via customisation options with some tiles and navigation preferences Provide the ability to tailor the game and its layout to the way you play, maximising the space on screen Introduce flows and options that make the experience more familiar to long-time FM players  Q: How have the navigation bars been addressed to help with navigation and discovery? A: Both the primary and secondary navigation bars at the very top of the screen have been revamped to be clearer and more helpful in finding what you need, faster. The majority of the options in the navigation bars include drop-downs so you can quickly find the area you need. For example, the Squad option drop-down includes the overview page, first team, youth team, dynamics and loans, some of which with their own drop-down menus with more specific pages. Additionally, in Preferences you’ll find a setting that allows you to change which screen is first the one you see when you click any option in the Primary navigation bar. For example, when selecting Squad, you can choose to be taken to a specific area, like the first team, rather than the overview.  Q: How customisable is the layout and information shown on screens?  A: You'll be able to change what you immediately see and access across multiple areas of FM27. Selected tiles that summarise key information can be swapped out for different tiles and topics. For example, on the Recruitment page a ‘Transfer Window’ tile appears by default, but this can be changed to show a wide variety of other options, including affiliate clubs or your transfer history. Customisation options for the layout of Bookmarks, Shortcuts and the landing screen for each key menu are also available, either via prompts on the screen or within the Preferences menu.  Q: Will FM27 support ultrawide monitors and different information layouts to suit the type of screen being used? A: Yes. FM27 includes ultrawide monitor support, which appears immediately once you load into the game when using a relevant monitor. Additionally, tables with large amounts of columns and information will rescale to show as much information as possible on ultrawide screens. Including the default option, there are three different scaling modes, available from Preferences, that allow you to load different amounts of information onto the screen, so you can maximise the space available to you. While fully optimised layouts for every possible screen and setup is not possible, a considerable amount of work has gone into minimising dead space for as many setups as possible.  Q: Will there be fewer cards compared to FM26? A: Yes. A priority in the FM27 design work has been to turn many of these information points into a full-screen experience, making it easier to find the details you need and including clear guidance on where next to navigate to.  Q: How does FM27 make it easier to find key actions to take in each main section of the game? A: Whenever you access the main screens in the game, such as Squad or Recruitment, you’ll find a control panel towards the top of the page, underneath the primary and secondary navigation options. This panel clearly displays important actions you can take in this area of the game, without navigating away from the main screen. For example, on the Recruitment screen, the control panel allows you to easily access recruitment advice from your staff; adjust your budgets; create a recruitment focus; change your scouting range and budget; and delegate staff responsibilities.   Q: How have news and messages been improved for FM27? A: News items will now be directly shown to you in the message you receive, rather than requiring you to click through or away.
